about.description: Island Wing Company specializes in baked, not fried food. Everything is baked, steamed, or grilled using fresh, clean ingredients with vegetarian and vegan options available.

menu.name: Cheesy Buffalo Chicken Dip
menu.description: Chicken, mild buffalo sauce, ranch, and a three-cheese blend. Served with tortilla chips.

menu.name: Crispy Coconut Shrimp
menu.description: Shrimp in coconut breading, baked golden, with tropical Asian sauce.

menu.name: Crispy Pickle Chips
menu.description: Panko-breaded pickle chips with ranch.

menu.name: Baked and Battered Green Beans
menu.description: Crispy-battered green beans with ranch or wasabi ranch.

menu.name: Basket of Island Fries
menu.description: Baked fries with two dipping sauces.

menu.name: Ahi Poke Nachos
menu.description: Wonton chips, ahi tuna, pineapple, spicy garlic teriyaki, Korean aioli, topped with sesame seeds and green onion.

menu.name: Beer Battered Mozzarella Sticks
menu.description: Mozzarella sticks with crispy batter and marinara.

menu.name: Chips & Fire Roasted Salsa
menu.description: Tortilla chips with salsa.

menu.name: Mini Crab Cakes
menu.description: Wild-caught claw meat, Chesapeake style, served with remoulade and green onions.

menu.name: Tuna Tataki
menu.description: Seared and thinly sliced tuna, tropical Asian sauce, cucumber wasabi aioli, served with spring mix, wontons, and carrots.

menu.name: House-Made Smoked Yellowfin Tuna Dip
menu.description: Smoked tuna with peppadews, pickled jalapeño, celery sticks, green onion, chipotle powder and crackers.

menu.name: Jumbo Pretzel
menu.description: Served with brew pub mustard.

menu.name: Cheese Quesadilla
menu.description: Grilled tortilla with Colby-Jack cheese. Served with a side of diced tomatoes, lettuce, sour cream, and jalapeños.

menu.name: BBQ Chicken & Bacon
menu.description: BBQ sauce, Colby-Jack cheese, chicken, bacon, and caramelized onions.

menu.name: Chicken Bacon Ranch
menu.description: Ranch, mozzarella, Parmesan, chicken, bacon and tomatoes.

menu.name: Margherita
menu.description: White sauce, basil, tomatoes, mozzarella, greens, and balsamic fig glaze.

menu.name: Pepperoni & Cheese
menu.description: Pepperoni, mozzarella cheese, and marinara sauce.

menu.name: Summer Berry Salad
menu.description: Greens with grilled chicken, blueberries, strawberries, pecans, feta, and raspberry balsamic vinaigrette.

menu.name: Buffalo Chicken Salad
menu.description: Greens with baked buffalo breaded chicken, tomatoes, cucumbers, cheese, and ranch.

menu.name: Greek Salad
menu.description: Greens with grilled chicken, tomatoes, feta, cucumbers, olives, onions, pepperoncinis, and Greek dressing.

menu.name: Sesame Seared Ahi Tuna Watermelon & Feta Salad
menu.description: Arcadian mix, cucumber, arugula, watermelon, feta, sliced tuna, lemon vinaigrette.

menu.name: Southwest Chicken Salad
menu.description: Greens with baked breaded chicken, corn, black beans, tortilla strips, tomatoes, Cheddar Jack cheese, and chipotle ranch.

menu.name: Island Chicken Grill
menu.description: Grilled chicken over reggae rice, with roasted veggies and Polynesian sauce.

menu.name: Blackened Mahi Mahi
menu.description: Blackened mahi topped with two grilled shrimp and a touch of rosemary, served over mashed potatoes and vegetables.

menu.name: Caribbean Shrimp
menu.description: Grilled jerk shrimp with rich, Caribbean jerk sauce, red and green bell peppers, roasted onions, sautéed pineapple, served with house-made reggae rice.

menu.name: Habanero Bacon Jam Pork Ribeye
menu.description: Two pork ribeyes glazed with habanero bacon jam served over mashed potatoes with roasted veggies.

menu.name: Bacon Wrapped Stuffed Shrimp
menu.description: 4 large shrimp stuffed with wild-caught claw meat, wrapped in bacon served over mashed potatoes with roasted veggies and remoulade sauce.

menu.name: Pina Colada
menu.description: Pineapple and coconut blended together with light rum for that smooth and creamy Island flavor. This drink is perfect with our crispy coconut shrimp!

menu.name: Rum Runner
menu.description: A blend of tropical fruits, fresh juices, and light rum that'll have you running back for another! Order one and relax, we'll do all the running for you!

menu.name: Hurricane
menu.description: Passion fruit puree and light and dark rums all blended at a Category 5 level. If you happen to blow through yours, don't worry, we'll get you another!

menu.name: Strawberry Daiquiri
menu.description: A classic on every island, so of course it's on our Island too! A mix of strawberry puree and light rum blended just right for that familiar flavor everyone loves.

menu.name: Mango Colada
menu.description: All the flavor of your favorite creamy concoction with a ribbon of fresh mango puree blended in to take it to a delicious new level.

menu.name: Margarita
menu.description: A refreshing blend of tangy margarita mix and gold tequila blended and chilled.

menu.name: Mango Margarita
menu.description: Everything you'd expect from a classic margarita with fresh mango puree added for a tasty island twist.

menu.name: Island Time
menu.description: Kick your feet up with this blend of dark rum, light rum, coconut cream, raspberry puree, and tangy key lime juice. Welcome to Island Time!

menu.name: Orange Dreamsicle
menu.description: It's everything you remember! Made with Grand Marnier Liqueur, Vanilla Vodka, Triple Sec, orange juice, coconut cream, and whipped cream.

menu.name: Bushwacker
menu.description: A boozy version of a milkshake for all of us big kids! A blend of light rum, 151 rum, coffee liqueur, chocolate liqueur, coconut cream, and half and half.

menu.name: Traditional
menu.description: Light Rum, fresh mint, freshly squeezed limes, simple syrup, and Sprite.

menu.name: Jalapeno Citrus
menu.description: Light Rum, fresh mint, fresh jalapeno slices, freshly squeezed limes, orange juice, and pineapple juice. Topped with a splash of Sprite.

menu.name: Raspberry
menu.description: Light Rum, fresh mint, freshly squeezed limes, and raspberry puree. Topped with Sprite.

menu.name: Mango
menu.description: Mango Rum, fresh mint, freshly squeezed limes, and mango puree. Topped with Sprite.

menu.name: Coconut Key Lime
menu.description: A delicious blend of Vanilla Vodka, Coconut Rum, coconut cream, and key lime juice.

menu.name: Montego Bay
menu.description: A fresh mixture of Vodka, Coconut Rum, mango puree, orange juice, pineapple juice, and grenadine.

menu.name: Island Cosmo
menu.description: A refreshing combination of Coconut Rum, Citrus Vodka, fresh lime juice, pomegranate juice, and grenadine.

menu.name: Mai Tai
menu.description: A tasty classic with an Island twist! Made with Dark Rum, Amaretto Liqueur, pineapple juice, and lemon juices.

menu.name: Baked on the Beach
menu.description: A refreshing blend of Vodka, Light Rum, Gin, Peach Schnapps, Triple Sec, pomegranate juice, and lemon juice. Topped with a splash of sprite.

menu.name: Sunset Celebration
menu.description: As the sun goes down, one of these drinks should go down too! A blend of Vodka, refreshing grapefruit juice.
